risk_explanation: This is an amendment/termination of a joint venture agreement rather than a standard SaaS contract, so many vendor-protective commercial terms (liability cap, termination notice, data processing) are not stated here. It includes survival of liability for pre-closing breaches and indemnity obligations for directors and officers, which can create open-ended exposure. Because key risk-limiting terms are absent/unclear, overall risk is medium for a small SaaS vendor.
